description: Public synthetic targets only; main comparison uses identical fine dose on CT-plane and recovered HDSS geometry. Exported-dose/library readouts are additional diagnostics.

refined_protocol.geometry: Unchanged ordinary Elements 4.5 RTSTRUCT; documented CT-plane thickness 1 mm, including single-plane contours.
refined_protocol.dose: Identical regular 1-mm original RTDOSE for every option at a given plan margin.
refined_protocol.main_comparator: inplane_0125, selected before inspection; inplane_00625 checks refinement. Inserted-plane variants are sensitivity checks, not selected by closest native-DVH agreement.
refined_protocol.implementation: In 0.5.6, inserted planes copy the nearest contour; no shape interpolation or original fine-source recovery. Endpoint weighting changes with the number of inserted planes.

controlled_comparison: Plane readout versus complete HDSS volume on the SAME native fine dose. Target field selection and physical trilinear interpolation are identical to primary full-volume analysis. Exported-dose and dicompyler readouts are separate diagnostics.
